item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Build intervention probes that test whether recommendations depend on recent intent or stale associations. Compare intact histories with recent-item removal, older-history removal, order shuffling, and uniform-history/last-item/residual ablations. Measure rank changes and residual contribution by category and history length; treat perturbation sensitivity as model dependence, not proof of user intent.","query":"sequential recommendation counterfactual history perturbation diagnostics recency sensitivity temporal intent drift residual history aggregation ablation 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Develop probes for the reported gap between broad similarity and specific usefulness. Use available titles and descriptions to construct auditable specification-conflict, fine-grained taste, and near-substitute candidate sets, with lexical extraction or locally fitted TF-IDF. Track ranking violations and redundant top-ranked items, connect failures to training negatives, and explicitly abstain when compatibility, ownership, or current demand cannot be established.","query":"recommendation diagnostics metadata hard negatives functional compatibility fine grained preference substitute redundancy top k title description weak supervision 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Establish whether new diagnostics are trustworthy and useful for model selection. Research negative-sampling bias, paired user bootstrap uncertainty, popularity/history-length slices, and calibration through controlled model degradations. Compare diagnostic predictions with the unchanged pinned macro validation HR@10 across residual controls; treat feedback from twenty training users as exploratory evidence rather than population estimates.","query":"recommender diagnostic metric validation controlled degradation sampled ranking evaluation 99 negatives full catalog disagreement paired bootstrap subgroup reliability 2024 2025 2026"}]}
